overview: A one-page list-of-papers or file-index sheet for State Department decimal file 894.7975, concerning automobile accidents in Japan. Paul Brown to settle the affair promptly might provoke an unpleasant incident.

subfiles.summary: The sheet identifies the subject as automobile accidents in Japan and lists Kobe report no. 307, associated with Scott and dated February 27. The report concerned the death of Yoshio Tsubiyama in an automobile accident. According to the index summary, officials feared that a “nasty incident” might arise unless A. Paul Brown brought the affair to a prompt resolution.

interest: Although only an index sheet survives here, it points to a potentially revealing consular case involving a fatal automobile accident and the management of ensuing tensions. Its language about “liquidating” the affair and avoiding a “nasty incident” may help historians trace how American officials handled private liability, compensation, and local relations in prewar Japan. The cross-reference to a personal name file also suggests a route for locating related documentation elsewhere in Record Group 59.
